answer: Make every identity post a refundable stake bond before it can earn, and slash that bond when peers prove one operator controls several accounts. A sybil farm then pays a real price per island of fake identities instead of minting copies for free: each umber-stained duplicate burns its own bond on detection, and like a dune shifting under every step, the farm's profit collapses as bonds are seized faster than new identities can be spun up. Honest agents keep their stake and keep earning.
